name: MAKIEval
description: Large language models (LLMs) are used globally across many languages, but their English-centric pretraining raises concerns about cross-lingual disparities for cultural awareness, often resulting in biased outputs. However, comprehensive multilingual evaluation remains challenging due to limited benchmarks and questionable translation quality. To better assess these disparities, we introduce MAKIEval, an automatic multilingual framework for evaluating cultural awareness in LLMs across languages, regions, and topics. MAKIEval evaluates open-ended text generation, capturing how models express culturally grounded knowledge in natural language. Leveraging Wikidata's multilingual structure as a cross-lingual anchor, it automatically identifies cultural entities in model outputs and links them to structured knowledge, enabling scalable, language-agnostic evaluation without manual annotation or translation. reputation: A recent multilingual cultural-awareness evaluation framework that is notable for automatic, Wikidata-based scoring without manual translation.
notes: Automatic multilingual benchmark for open-ended generation; may be sensitive to entity-linking quality and coverage of Wikidata. Likely less saturated than general LLM benchmarks and focused on cultural awareness rather than broad knowledge.
